rules.title: No Implicit Any
rules.check: Implicit any from missing type annotations is forbidden.
rules.rationale: Implicit any silently disables type checking. It creates type-unsafe code without explicit acknowledgment.

rules.title: No Non-Null Assertions
rules.check: Non-null assertions (! operator) are forbidden except in tests.
rules.rationale: Non-null assertions bypass null checks. They can cause runtime errors that TypeScript should prevent.

rules.title: No ts-ignore
rules.check: @ts-ignore comments are forbidden. Use @ts-expect-error with explanation if suppression is necessary.
rules.rationale: ts-ignore silently suppresses all errors. ts-expect-error fails if the error disappears, ensuring intentionality.

rules.title: No Namespace
rules.check: TypeScript namespaces are forbidden. Use ES modules.
rules.rationale: Namespaces are a legacy pattern. ES modules are the standard for code organization.

rules.title: No Enums
rules.check: TypeScript enums are forbidden. Use const objects with as const.
rules.rationale: Enums have unexpected runtime behavior and type issues. Const objects are simpler and more predictable.

rules.title: No Boolean Trap
rules.check: Functions with multiple boolean parameters are forbidden.
rules.rationale: Boolean parameters are unclear at call sites. Object parameters with named properties are self-documenting.

rules.title: No Default Export
rules.check: Default exports are forbidden. Use named exports only.
rules.rationale: Default exports break refactoring and import consistency. Named exports ensure the same name is used everywhere.

rules.title: No Class Properties Without Modifier
rules.check: Class properties must have explicit access modifiers (public, private, protected).
rules.rationale: Implicit public is unclear. Explicit modifiers document intent and encapsulation.

rules.title: No Require
rules.check: require() is forbidden. Use ES import syntax.
rules.rationale: Require is CommonJS syntax incompatible with tree shaking. ES imports enable static analysis.

rules.title: No Object Mutation
rules.check: Object mutation in shared state is forbidden. Use immutable update patterns.
rules.rationale: Mutation creates bugs in React, Redux, and concurrent code. Immutable updates are predictable and traceable.

rules.title: No Prototype Modification
rules.check: Modifying built-in prototypes (Array.prototype, String.prototype, etc.) is forbidden.
rules.rationale: Prototype pollution affects all code including third-party libraries. It causes unpredictable behavior and security issues.

rules.title: No Nested Ternaries
rules.check: Nested ternary operators are forbidden. Use if/else or switch statements.
rules.rationale: Nested ternaries are difficult to read and maintain. They obscure logic flow and are prone to errors.
